name: Particle Burst
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' PRTC: three fixed-interval resonant filters, a chord above the note, re-struck by a shared decaying noise burst at a random rate. Plaits' particle-noise scatters six particles around one pitch instead -- a cloud, not a chord.

controls.label: Scatter
controls.description: Jitters each filter around its own fixed interval; the lowest one jitters about three quarters as far as the other two.

controls.label: Density
controls.description: Sets how often a burst fires, from a few sparse ticks a second to a dense rattle.

controls.label: Chord width
controls.description: Scales the three filters' fixed intervals from unison, through the module's own voicing, to double the spread.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: Reshapes the burst envelope from a short tick, through the module's fixed length, to a long bloom.

outputs.aux: Mono: the raw decaying-noise burst before filtering. Stereo: a second, fully independent filter bank and RNG stream, for genuinely decorrelated left and right bursts.

trigger: The engine itself ignores TRIG and its random bursts keep running; Plaits' shared envelope still shapes a patched note.
